**Management Summary – Project LV 354,840 €**

The audit identified multiple 100 % duplicate cost items across the three work packages (8.1, 8.2, 8.3). High‑risk duplicates total ≈ €388,000, exceeding the contract sum and indicating potential double billing. Key duplicated categories are:

- **Module sub‑structures (8.2.60 & 8.3.60)** – €39,900 each (3 instances)  
- **PV modules 450 Wp (8.2.10 & 8.3.10)** – €28,320 each (4 instances)  
- **Inverters 50 kW (8.2.20 & 8.3.20)** – €19,400 each (3 instances)  
- **DC cable works (8.2.30 & 8.3.30)** – €6,840 each (6 instances, some at 94 % similarity)

Immediate actions: verify scope definitions, consolidate overlapping OZ codes, and adjust the estimate to eliminate duplicate payments. This will safeguard budget integrity and reduce exposure to audit findings.
